headline: Skyworks posts agentic AMS platform roles with verification-data integration and evaluation
fact: Skyworks listed a Cedar Rapids AI/software-workflow co-op on August 20 and a central design-automation role on August 24 describing an AI-enabled, agentic AMS design/verification platform and RNM workflows. On September 24, Irvine co-op requisition 78496 explicitly described a platform under development for mixed-signal verification debug and closure. It assigns agent tool use, retrieval and evaluation using real verification data, connections to testbenches, simulation logs, waveforms and coverage, and quality reporting. These advertisements strengthen the platform-development signal without establishing deployment or a shared platform/team across all three roles.

sources.summary: Official posting start date is August 20, 2026; the work term is January–June 2027. The current title and duties concern AI/software workflow development, with HDL and behavioral modeling as desired background; the URL retains an older title.

sources.summary: Official posting start date is September 24, 2026; January–June 2027 is the work term.
